grain: One accepted golden customer per current snapshot
quality_rules: Golden keys and source-system identity keys are unique.
Accepted mappings resolve to a golden customer; quarantined mappings never carry an approved golden ID.
Conflicting current entity payloads are quarantined, not chosen arbitrarily.
Past-due amounts and DPD must be nonnegative; invalid required dates are quarantined.
Case-account and interaction links must agree on the golden customer.
Credit and loan amounts aggregate independently of cases and interactions; deposit balances are separate.
Missing money remains null; known-balance and linked-account counts describe coverage.
Matching-only PII and protected attributes are excluded from this product.
prohibited_uses: Historical training without point-in-time feature validation

refresh.prototype: Manual transactional rebuild using pipeline.py build
refresh.target: Daily, subject to confirmed upstream availability
refresh.failure_handling: Rollback the database transaction and preserve the prior successful build. Never treat a failed rebuild as fresh data.

limitations: Confidence is an evidence category, not a calibrated probability.
CRM duplicate pointer chains and uncertain identity matches require review.
Amounts cover accepted linked accounts only; unmatched accounts are not implicitly zero.
Financial hardship is a recorded case fact, not inferred from a deposit balance.
DuckDB schema separation is organizational, not an access-control boundary. The local app checks account roles and agent case assignments; direct database access remains a deployment responsibility.
Consent/action gates are applied by the assistance layer, not this financial product. Historical point-in-time feature snapshots are not implemented.
design_basis: Release example DC-COLL-001 adapted from contact_history to the golden C360 product
